# CVCS Fleet Washing

> Mobile fleet washing and cleaning specialists serving Leinster, Ireland, 24/7. Part of the CVCS network (cvcs.ie). The only fleet washing company in Ireland that provides, fits and maintains charcoal drain filters tested to comply with EU regulations.

## Services

- HGV & truck washing: rigid and articulated units, chassis, wheels and cab
- Trailer washing: curtainsiders, box trailers, flatbeds and reefers
- Food transport hygiene: cleaning and sanitising of refrigerated and food delivery vehicles
- Van & LCV fleet washing: delivery, service and trade fleets
- Bus & coach cleaning: exterior washing and interior cleaning
- Plant & machinery: heavy-duty degreasing for construction and agricultural plant
- Cab interior valet
- Contract fleet programmes: scheduled weekly or monthly washing, nights and weekends available
- Charcoal drain filters: provide, fit and maintain EU-compliant filtration for wash water runoff

## Key facts

- Service area: Leinster, Ireland
- Hours: 24/7
- Fully mobile: comes to the customer's yard or depot
- Clients include An Post, Bord na Móna, Brink's, Bunzl, Bus Éireann, BWG Foods, Calor, Diageo, Dunnes Stores, JJK Coach Hire, Musgrave, Panda Waste, Seabridge, SPAR, Texaco, Goggins Transport, First Glass Ltd, Asia Market, M&S and AES
